answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a renewable work credential: each identity completes one fresh task per epoch, and each extra fake identity costs its operator about 420 seconds of compute plus a unique input. N sybils mean N x 420 seconds and N distinct inputs, while an honest agent simply renews it, paying nothing. Each credential is burned after use and reissued fresh, so a ring cannot reuse one success. At dawn, 500 identities need 500 fresh tasks, while the honest cost stays flat. The credential is like an ivory token, and it fades unless renewed, like a willow holding the bank.
